messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: east-core GPU pool queue growth > 15k. Autoscaler reached max_replicas=48 and further scale attempts are failing. Paging oncall @maya. Possible cross-region reroute needed.

pagerduty-bot: Triggered: High GPU queue growth (alert_id=PD-84721). Priority: P0. Escalation: maya -> liam -> anita.

maya (sre-oncall): I'm on it. Gathering quick context — which jobs are queuing? are these gen text endpoints or embeddings?

liam (runtime): Mostly text-generation (chat) routes  /v1/chat and a small spike in embeddings. Queue growth pattern shows steady enqueue, but KV cache warm rate low. Autoscaler logs show provisioning attempts erroring out.

liam (runtime): snippet from autoscaler logs:
```
2026-03-12T03:12:07Z ERROR provisioner.go:182 failed to create node pool: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded in project, quotaExceeded
2026-03-12T03:12:12Z WARN autoscaler.go:344 reached max_replicas=48, no further scale up attempted
```

anita (infra): Confirmed — GCP quota request still pending (ticket INC-2026-392). Zone reports capacityExceeded on a handful of machine types. We can't get new GPUs in east-core until quota & capacity clear.

jordan (support): Customer impact — I'm seeing ~12% 503s and 20%+ P95 latency increase for some tenants. Affected tenants flagged: alpha-saas, retail-ml, beta-qa (non-prod canaries). Notifying key CSMs now.

maya (sre-oncall): Rough estimate on traffic reroute? Is geo-steer set to spill to west1 with model-fallback?

kyle (network): Yes, current geo-steer policy for east-core is: prefer east until healthy, then west as fallback. Default model fallback is downgraded-quant (lower cost variant). We can flip traffic to west1 but need to be careful about cold KV cache and initial latency spike.

liam (runtime): We should do a controlled cutover: (1) set cross-region fallback to immediate (weight 100%), (2) throttle non-critical routes (embeddings, long-context) by 50%, (3) reduce per-request concurrency on chat endpoints to 2. That will reduce enqueue pressure.

maya (sre-oncall): Agreed. @anita can you authorize the cross-region config flip? I'll run the runtime changes.

anita (infra): Authorizing. Also opening emergency quota escalation with GCP — but that's long lead. Execute reroute now.

liam (runtime): Executing routing change via control plane API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing/modify -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"selector":"east-core","fallback":"west1","fallback_mode":"immediate","weight":100}'
```
Response: 200 OK — routing change accepted, rollout_id=rr-5532.

incidents-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: rollout rr-5532 started. Target: east-core -> west1 immediate.

jordan (support): I'm seeing traffic shift ~10% -> west in the first minute. Alpha-saas reports degraded but successful responses. Retail-ml still seeing some 503s (likely sticky sessions). Flagging for engineering to check session affinity.

liam (runtime): Flipping throttles and concurrency:
```bash
# throttle embeddings routes by 50%
redwoodctl routes update --route "/v1/embeddings" --concurrency 1 --throttle 50
# reduce chat concurrency
redwoodctl routes update --route "/v1/chat" --concurrency 2
```
Outputs: applied.

maya (sre-oncall): Observability check: token-level cost looks stable, queue depth for east-core dropping from 15k -> 3.2k in next 10 minutes. West1 instance latency P95 jumped from 120ms -> 480ms but error rate dropped overall.

kyle (network): Noted: west1 KV cache misses ~95% initially, expecting warm-up ~30-45m depending on traffic. Consider enabling prefix cache warmers for high-volume tenants.

support-esc: Customer communications: Sent short status to impacted tenants: "We are routing traffic to an alternate region to restore throughput. Some responses may be slower. Engineering working on permanent fix."

jordan (support): Alpha-saas reports degraded UX but functional. Beta-qa back to normal. Retail-ml still has 2% error rate — investigating application-level session stickiness.

liam (runtime): Pulled a quick telemetry diff: total requests dropped 18% (throttles + reroute). Success rate improved from 88% -> 95% after reroute. CPU/GPU utilization in west1 rose but within acceptable SLOs.

maya (sre-oncall): Good. We're stabilizing. Open action items: (A) infra to continue quota & capacity escalation with GCP (anita), (B) runtime to add a transient cache-warming job for top tenants (liam), (C) network to review session affinity policy (kyle), (D) support to update customers in 30m (jordan).

anita (infra): GCP escalation updated: INC-2026-392 -> now labeled SEV, contact assigned. ETA unknown. I'll also provision a small reserved pool in west1 to reduce future cross-region cold start pain.

liam (runtime): Quick cache-warm plan (inline): spawn controlled synthetic requests for top 10 tenants using cached prefixes to populate KV stores in west1. Schedule now with low rate.

kyle (network): I'll temporarily relax affinity rules to allow deterministic distribution across west1 nodes (will break strict session pinning but reduces failure).

support-esc: Customer update drafted and posted to CSMs.

maya (sre-oncall): Monitoring for next 60m. If queue re-trends up, escalate to exec. For now this is mitigation. Creating incident ticket and assigning postmortem owners.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (cross-region reroute + throttles + concurrency reduction). Queue depth decreased. Impact: intermittent slow responses for some tenants, partial failures resolved. Assigned: anita, liam, kyle, jordan for follow-ups.

maya (sre-oncall): Closing timeline note: 03:12 Alert -> 03:18 routing flip started -> 03:40 queue stable below 4k -> 04:00 ongoing cache warm-up. Postmortem will cover autoscaler max_replicas failure mode and geo-steer readiness.

jordan (support): Will send a stakeholder summary in 1h.

liam (runtime): Next action: add autoscaler better visibility for quota rejections and auto-initiate geo-cutover when provisioning is blocked for > 2m. Filing ticket: RUNTIME-1384.

anita (infra): And I'll push for pre-provision reservations in critical zones; adding runbook step to pre-warm west1 in failover cases.

maya (sre-oncall): Thanks all. Holding oncall until 06:00 UTC for any regressions.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: thread will be archived after incident postmortem.
